# Light reaction

Happens in the thylakoid membrane
Splits water, releases O2
**Produces ATP and NADPH**

# Dark reaction (Calvin cycle)

Happens in the stroma
Uses ATP + NADPH to fix CO2
**Key enzyme: RuBisCO**

# Exam tip

Do not confuse stroma with cytoplasm

## 关联概念

- [[#Light reaction]] → Dark reaction (Calvin cycle)（推导）

Calculus - Limits

微积分 · 极限

课程目录：未分类
BEFORE · 手写原图

纸面笔记：只能看，不能搜、不能连、不能复用。

AFTER · NoteFlow 产出

Definition

lim f(x) as x approaches a equals L

Left limit must equal right limit

Two important limits

sin x / x -> 1 when x -> 0

(1 + 1/n)^n -> e when n -> infinity

Common mistake

Cancel terms before checking 0/0

Always verify the domain first

# Definition

lim f(x) as x approaches a equals L
**Left limit must equal right limit**

# Two important limits

sin x / x -> 1 when x -> 0
(1 + 1/n)^n -> e when n -> infinity

# Common mistake

Cancel terms before checking 0/0
Always verify the domain first
